text: ok just making sure so if i remove / move / rename the image, its going to fail
resolution: Confirmation Q&A, no code change. Confirmed: removing/moving/renaming the source image breaks the EDITOR immediately (painter/iso3d load the image by path every render — the face goes blank) and the NEXT bake warns + skips it (degrades, never crashes), so the new gamefile loses the image. Exception spelled out: already-compiled gamefiles keep working forever because the bake installed the bytes content-addressed in zig-out/game/contentstore/ — the original is load-bearing for authoring only, not for playing what is already baked. Re-offered the import-copies-into-app-data feature as the durable cure if they want the app to own dropped images.
